gameDescriptionHtml:
Get ready to be immersed in the best tropical paradise experience, where your skills seduce the women of your dreams!

Travel to a tropical island where an old hotel awaits you, full of mysteries, problems, and temptations. You are the only man within hundreds of kilometers, and everyone will need your help.

You’re a real handyman, and all the ladies know it! Show them what you can do with your hands in realistic activities such as pool, fishing, yachting, and coconut oil massage…

Explore a small open world from a first-person perspective. Freely move around the island, visit the hotel, beach, lighthouse, and jungle, discover hidden paths, and unlock new ways to interact with characters.

Keep the ladies happy, and they’ll let you into their hotel room for scenes so hot they make adult stars jealous! Change positions and unlock them all to become the ultimate tropical playboy.

Realistic characters and highly detailed environments create the atmosphere of a true resort adventure, where every action can lead to new events and intimate encounters.

Get away from all your troubles and take the girls on sexy adventures on the hunt for your grandfather’s buried treasure. Better get your whip and hat ready to unravel an ancient mystery. Will you get to the real treasure?
